complete_serial_numbers.description: All complete banknote serial numbers readable anywhere in the image. Exclude partial serial numbers; do not join text from different fragments to invent a complete serial. Return each distinct value once, in any order. Use [] when none are readable; do not reconstruct missing text.

currency_code.description: Three-letter currency code of the banknotes.

original_total_value.description: Exact total face value of the original banknotes before shredding.
